ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well, the president at the local during that time, Lewis Contrell, and the boy that did the section was Lord Washington, Poirier, and myself and, uh, who was that fellow, that bass player, man? Uh, uh, uh, Kimball. Norvin Kimball. Norvin Kimball. Norvin Kimball, yeah.
